training_decision: no_retraining: current bottlenecks are candidate coverage, missing information, and model-domain mismatch; all old-model results labeled out_of_domain
simulation_adoption_policy: explicit_evaluation_only: at each arrival adopt reviewed minimum lexicographic stability candidate iff current plan fails mandatory future checks; if current plan passes retain unchanged; never connected to Web auto-adoption
scope: Synthetic finite-graph software sequence evaluation, no optimality/completeness or field deployment claims
grouping_correction: All derivatives of a hand-defined topology remain together. Three new hand-defined topologies are test-only; no new model selection/training/calibration.
budget_scope: Shared deadline for constraint generation, features, inference, initial checks, baseline review, search and candidate review. Evidence accounting/adoption/export afterwards separately timed; overruns disclosed.
